title: GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a convex function f: ℝ^d → ℝ, with a global minimizer xstar satisfying ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle returns ∇f(x) at arbitrary query points. Every history and seed must yield the exact gradient; function values are not returned. Algorithms may be randomized and have unrestricted query and output rules.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt clause; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: spec.Query and spec.Reply; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm and Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient map is differentiable everywhere and satisfies ‖D(∇f)(x)‖ ≤ L0 + L1‖∇f(x)‖ globally. Here L0 > 0 and L1 ≥ 0; no global constant bound on the Hessian is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, Differentiable and fderiv clauses; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is Euclidean ℝ^d, with d ≥ ⌈17592186044416(1 + L1R + √(L0R²/ε))^5⌉.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters d, L0, L1, x0, R, ε are public; the objective is hidden. R > 0 and 0 < ε ≤ L0R²/16. A minimizer lies within distance R of x0, without a separately supplied initial objective-gap bound.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.valid; LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return an arbitrary point xhat ∈ ℝ^d with integrable objective gap f(xhat) − f(xstar), where xstar is a global minimizer, and expected gap at most ε.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The requirement is E[f(xhat) − f(xstar)] ≤ ε under the execution law, allowing algorithm randomization. It is not an almost-sure accuracy requirement.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex exact-gradient optimization with gradient-dependent curvature and an explicit parameter-dependent high-dimensional regime.

descriptionHtml:
Generalized Smooth Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing a convex function f:Rd→R in dimension d∈N. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth, meaning its differentiable gradient satisfies ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥ everywhere, with L0>0 and L1≥0. A given point x0∈Rd lies within distance R>0 of a global minimizer x⋆. The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. For a tolerance ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈Rd with integrable objective gap and EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Rdf(x). We use the Euclidean norm and its induced operator norm. The parameters obey L0>0,L1≥0,R>0,0<ε≤L0R216,d≥⌈17592186044416(1+L1R+L0R2ε)5⌉. The algorithm receives d, L0, L1, x0, R, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity). For every x,y∈Rd and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y).

Assumption 2 (Generalized smoothness). The function f is differentiable everywhere, its gradient is Fréchet differentiable everywhere, and ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥,x∈Rd. Here ∇2f(x):Rd→Rd is the derivative of the gradient.

Assumption 3 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈Rd such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈Rd,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Queries may be made at any point of Rd. After the allotted oracle calls, the output must have an integrable objective gap under P and satisfy EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε.

theorems.referencesHtml: • Mikhail Rudomanov, Ivan Fomin, Alexander V. Gasnikov, and Fedor S. Stonyakin. Descending Everest with First-Order Oracles: Oracle Complexity of Convex Optimization under (L0,L1)-Smoothness. 2026 (preprint v1, 15 October). Complexity: 1+N=Ω(1+L0R2/ε+L1R/log⁡(2+L1R)) necessary exact value-and-gradient oracle calls for arbitrary deterministic methods achieving f(x^)−f∗≤ε, in the worst case over Euclidean dimensions; L0,L1,R>0 and ε≤L0R2.
theorems.formulaHtml: ⌊L0⋅R2ε+L1⋅Rlog⁡(2+L1⋅R)8388608⌋+

comparisonHtml:
Convex f:Rd→R has a differentiable gradient with ∥∇2f(x)∥≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥ and a minimizer x⋆ satisfying ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. Public parameters satisfy L0,R,ε>0, L1≥0, ε≤L0R2/16, and d≥⌈244(1+L1R+L0R2/ε)5⌉. Arbitrary adaptive randomized algorithms receive exact gradients. The target is integrable expected objective error ∫[f(x^(ω))−f(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε, where P is the algorithm’s seed law.

(2) (Rudomanov et al. 2026a), Thm. 4.10 Lower bound: 1+N=Ω(1+L0R2/ε+L1Rlog⁡(2+L1R)) value–gradient calls; deterministic; ε≤L0R2. (3) Classical smooth lower bound (Garg et al. 2021), Secs. 1–2; L1=0, ball-domain model Lower bound: N=Ω(L0R2/ε) value–gradient calls; randomized, high dimension. (1): Scope: extends to L1>0, adding L1R/log⁡(2+L1R); matches classical smooth accuracy scaling at L1=0. (1): Gradient-only hardness. Ball-domain and unrestricted-query models differ; full oracle-complexity bounds are not directly comparable.
(4) (Rudomanov et al. 2026b), Thm. 7.1; finite sums Lower bound: Ω(T0/log2⁡N0) expected component value–gradient calls. Requires n≥2, δ>0, L12R2δ/ε≥3, Δ≥2ε; convex C2 components bounded below, ∥∇2fi∥≤L0,i+L1∥∇fi∥, n−1∑iL0,i≤L0. (1): Single-function randomized hardness at fixed budgets. Rates not comparable: no established n=1 reduction; identical components have δ=0, outside (4)’s range.

Abbr: N: oracle-call budget; Ω: necessary-budget lower bound, with universal constants suppressed. In (4), f=n−1∑ifi, Δ≥f(x0)−f(x⋆), δ≥f(x⋆)−n−1∑iinffi; T0=n(1+(L1R)2/3)+n(L0+L12δ)R2/ε+n(L1R)2 and N0=4+n+(L0+L12δ)R2/ε+(L1R)2.

import LongTails.Setups.RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

namespace LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

noncomputable abbrev Params.toRadiusOnly (p : Params) : RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.Params :=
  { E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d), L0 := p.L0, L1 := p.L1, x0 := p.x0,
    R := p.R, ε := p.ε }

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d) → ℝ
  Query p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Reply p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Output p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  publicInput := id
  valid p := 0 < p.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ p.L1 ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧
    p.ε ≤ p.L0 * p.R ^ 2 / 16 ∧
    ⌈17592186044416 * (1 + p.L1 * p.R + Real.sqrt (p.L0 * p.R ^ 2 / p.ε)) ^ 5⌉₊ ≤ p.d
  admissible p := RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.spec.admissible p.toRadiusOnly
  successful p f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f (output ω) - f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, f (output ω) - f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull
